instruction: Help me configure VLC to save screenshots in JPEG format instead of the default PNG

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires user to change VLC screenshot format setting from default 'png' to 'jpg'. The evaluator reads the vlcrc configuration file and checks if 'snapshot-format=jpg' is set. This is verified by checking the standard VLC configuration parameter 'snapshot-format' which controls the image format for screenshots.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement: changing VLC screenshot format from PNG to JPEG
Getter (get_vlc_config) properly reads VLC configuration file from OS-specific paths
Metric (check_vlc_screenshot_format__bb7a94b9) correctly parses vlcrc file for 'snapshot-format' setting
Expected value 'jpg' is semantically correct - VLC uses 'jpg' (not 'jpeg') in config files
Parameter handling is correct: expected parameter receives rules dict directly, accessed via expected.get('screenshot_format')
Edge cases handled appropriately: FileNotFoundError, parsing exceptions, defaults to 'png' when setting not found
Complete coverage: single-step instruction fully verified by checking the exact config parameter
No postconfig needed: VLC config persists in file system and is accessible after task completion
